name: Etched Parchment
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Etched Parchment calls a young hunter to Jen'shan. Gornek delivers it after the initiate's first blooding, opening the way to wilderness training in Durotar.

sections.title: A Summons from the Wild
sections.body: After proving themselves against mottled boars, hunters in the Valley of Trials receive an etched parchment from Gornek. Jen'shan, a skilled Darkspear hunter, sent the note after watching new arrivals from the edges of the encampment. It welcomes the initiate to formal training and recognizes the instincts needed to master Durotar's untamed beasts and harsh land.

sections.title: The Hunter's Way
sections.body: Reporting to Jen'shan marks the move from recruit to dedicated stalker. She warns that hunting is no easier than the arcane arts or ancestral shamanism. Mastering Durotar's predators, maintaining ranged weapons, and surviving on unforgiving land all demand discipline. Jen'shan sends her apprentices to aid the valley's other inhabitants and test their abilities before returning to learn more advanced survival techniques.

faq.answer: Etched Parchment is a written summons from Gornek on behalf of Jen'shan, the hunter trainer. It calls promising recruits to her for specialized martial and wilderness instruction in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Who delivers this summons to the player?
aliases: where do i get the quest
faq.answer: Gornek gives you the parchment after your first trial, slaying mottled boars in the Valley of Trials.
Jen'shan is a Darkspear troll hunter stationed in the Valley of Trials. She evaluates new orc and troll hunters and teaches ranged warfare, tracking, and beastcraft.

faq.q: Why does Jen'shan compare hunters to mages and shamans?
faq.answer: Jen'shan warns that many mistake hunting for an easier path than ancestral spirits or arcane magic. Lethal marksmanship and mastery of wild beasts demand equal dedication and carry equal danger.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Jen'shan?
faq.answer: Jen'shan introduces you to advanced hunter techniques and sends you to aid the Valley of Trials' other inhabitants. You practice your newly acquired skills through practical survival.
Only newly created orc hunters training in the Valley of Trials can receive it.

angles.text: As a hunter, this summons points you to Jen'shan to refine your aim and understand the wild.
As a Darkspear recruit, studying under Jen'shan keeps alive the ancient jungle tracking traditions carried from the Echo Isles.
As an orc, you rely on mentors like Jen'shan to adapt clan hunting methods to Durotar's arid crags and deadly beasts.
As a Horde hunter, you scout the borders and feed the camps. Early training helps keep Durotar supplied and guarded.
